8.
(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the
principal enactment and in the provisions of this Act -

(a)
every power of attorney executed prior to the date of
commencement  of  this  Act  which  has  not  been
registered  under  the  provisions  of  section  3  of  the
principal enactment and which has not been revoked
or cancelled on or prior to the date of commencement
of this Act, shall, within a period of six months from
the date of commencement of this Act, be submitted
for registration to the Registrar General;
